title: Phase 9 Change Request ticket (.methodology/change_requests/CR-NNN.json)
description: Maintenance-phase work unit. type=bug maps to ASPICE SUP.9 (Problem Resolution Management), type=feat maps to ASPICE SUP.10 (Change Request Management). Managed by core/maintenance/cr_manager.py; closure evidence follows the bug_hunt_report anti-fabrication contract (resolved needs fix_commit AND, for bugs, an existing repro_test file).

severity.description: bug: problem severity (SUP.9 classification); feat: priority

affected_frs.description: bug: existing FRs whose behavior is wrong; feat: new or changed FR IDs. Every listed FR must re-pass Gate 1 before closure.

impact_analysis.description: SUP.10 analysis: which artifacts this CR touches. cr-close verifies the touched artifacts were actually updated.

modules.description: source modules touched (new modules require SAB amendment)

root_cause.description: bug only — required before APPROVED (SUP.9 analysis step)

repro_test.description: bug only — project-relative path of the failing repro test, required before APPROVED; the file must exist (anti-fabrication)

approval.description: feat only — required before APPROVED (SUP.10 approval decision)

gate1_results.description: FR-XX -> Gate 1 score recorded at closure
